stateNote: Heat a pan on medium heat and add a few tablespoons of oil. Place a spoonful of batter in the pan, and flatten with a spatula. You should be aiming for no more than 4 inches in diameter, as larger ones will lack integrity. Cook for 3–4 minutes, then flip with the spatula, and cook for another 3–4 minutes. Add more oil to the pan as needed.
